title: Payment of Certain Sums by Certain Individuals or Hindu Undivided Family (Section 194M)

effectivePeriod.sunsetNotes: Transitions to Section 393(1) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 effective 1 April 2026.

plainTextSummary: Any person, being an individual or a Hindu undivided family (other than those who are required to deduct income-tax as per the provisions of section 194C, section 194H or section 194J), responsible for paying any sum to any resident for carrying out any work (including supply of labour) in pursuance of a contract, by way of commission or brokerage, or by way of fees for professional services during the financial year, shall deduct an amount equal to 2% (reduced from 5% w.e.f. 1 October 2024 by Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024) if such sum or aggregate of sums exceeds fifty lakh rupees in a financial year.

keyStatutoryThresholds.tanRequirement: No TAN required. Payment is remitted using PAN via Form 26QD within 30 days of the end of the month of deduction.

officialCitations.subject: Procedure for deduction and deposit of tax under Section 194M via Form 26QD and Form 16D
Rationalization of TDS rates under Section 194M from 5% to 2% effective 1 October 2024

requiredDocumentChecklist: Work Contract / Commission Agreement / Professional Engagement Letter
Invoices or payment vouchers issued by contractor/professional
Permanent Account Number (PAN) of Contractor / Professional / Broker
Permanent Account Number (PAN) of Deductor (Individual / HUF)
Form 16D TDS Certificate issued to Payee
